title: Djokovic Wins in Beijing for First Victory Since Wimbledon
summary:
Novak Djokovic has won his first tennis match since he reached the Wimbledon semi-finals in July.

The 39-year-old from Serbia beat Nuno Borges of Portugal 6-3, 7-6 (7-2) at the China Open in Beijing. It was his 30th win in a row at this tournament. He has won the China Open six times, and he wants to win it a record seventh time. He had not played in the event since 2015.

The match was not easy. In the second set, Djokovic used his racket to help stretch his back between games. He also stopped for a medical timeout so he could get treatment on his right shoulder.

In August, Djokovic said he has a health condition that causes problems in hot, humid weather. He said it has been going on for "the past couple of years." He was far from his best against Borges. Still, he kept playing and won after one hour and 50 minutes.

Next, he will play Bu Yunchaokete of China. Bu is a wildcard, a player who got a special invitation to enter the tournament.

In the women's draw, Katie Boulter of Great Britain also won. She beat Mai Hontama of Japan 6-3, 6-4. Boulter is 30. She will play Karolina Muchova of the Czech Republic in the next round.
why_it_matters: It shows how an athlete can keep playing and win even when a match is hard.
